children: Overview
U.S. frozen Italian foods maker's Q3 net sales rose 10% yr/yr, led by foodservice and international growth
Non-GAAP net income and EPS rose double digits; reported EPS fell 3% due to facility relocation costs
Company expanded secondary sauces and international sales; manufacturing expansion remains on schedule
Outlook
Company anticipates inflation, tariffs, and commodity cost pressures to intensify in Q4
Company expects manufacturing transition expenses and inventory investments to continue into Q2 2027
Company targets Mountain House facility production start in Q2 2027
Result Drivers
FOODSERVICE AND INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co said Q3 net sales rose 10% yr/yr, driven by momentum in core U.S. Foodservice, National Accounts, and International markets
SECONDARY SAUCES EXPANSION - Co reported 20% growth in secondary sauces, reflecting progress in expanding specialty sauces beyond pesto
FACILITY RELOCATION COSTS - Reported profit metrics were affected by costs related to relocating production to the new Mountain House facility
